channel.description: What changed in Mawkingbird, the Mastodon and Bluesky client, and why.

item.title: Find your people: Mastodon communities by interest
item.description:
A new Mastodon account starts with an empty timeline. Finding the people who post about what you care about is the slow part, and it is where many people give up.

Mastodon communities by interest is our answer. Each page covers one interest and gathers three things:

  • Hashtags people actually use for that interest.
  • People worth following, from writers and YouTubers to active community members.
  • Servers where the community meets.

You can read all of it, and preview the feed it would build, before you make an account.

The first topics

  • Science fiction & fantasy
  • Space & astronomy
  • Math
  • Gardening & houseplants
  • Plant-based living
  • ESP32 & single-board computers

Not only in English

Pages are written for readers in their own language: German, French, Spanish, Italian and Japanese so far, depending on the topic. Beside the busy English hashtags, they suggest local ones, so smaller language communities can grow their own.

Then build your feed

When you are ready, pick the tags and people you want, sign in with any Mastodon account, and Mawkingbird follows them for you. If a hashtag turns out to be flooded by a few very busy accounts, the page helps you spot them and mute them before they take over your timeline.

Tell us which interest should come next by replying to this post on Mastodon.

item.title: Release notes: radio, forums and a calmer menu
item.description:
Mawkingbird is a Mastodon and Bluesky client that runs in your browser. Here is what changed between mid-October and early November.

Listening and reading

  • Radio. Posts that share music and audio now play as a radio station, with a Listen page, embeds from common audio sites and preferences for what plays.
  • Studio for preparing audio posts and finding your audio that is ready to share.
  • Forum. A new mode that finds the people talking to each other in a feed and shows each conversation as a whole discussion.
  • Slide show for posts with several images.
  • Read later got better.

Finding things

  • Similar hashtags suggest tags next to the one you're reading.
  • Mastodon communities by interest: see the launch post.
  • Home timeline tuning has new options.

Getting around

  • App modes and a reworked, slimmer main menu.
  • Layout fixes on profiles, on the home toolbar and in the account picker.
  • A retry button when a page fails to load.
  • Images are no longer lost when you edit a post.

Bluesky

  • Many fixes and improvements for Bluesky accounts across the app.

Free tools, in more languages

  • New single-purpose tools, such as downloading a post's media and saving bookmarks.
  • Guides for people arriving from Twitter.
  • Every language the app is translated into now has its own landing pages.

Questions or bugs? Reply to this post on Mastodon, or see Help.
